protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: smb2_add_iovector() writes v->iov[v->niov] and increments niov without checking the fixed SMB2_MAX_VECTORS=256 array. The receive loop introduced by 189e5ed retains smb2->in across NextCommand PDUs, appends header/fixed/variable/padding vectors, and loops through read_more_data, so attacker-controlled chaining can exceed the array. The later OPLOCK_BREAK message-id exception in b98e497/ebb60e9 amplifies reachability but is not the overflow's first-write mechanism.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: 189e5edab3ae792fc3d6d6a414d7166b57a269c6 is the earliest public commit found by content history that adds is_chained = smb2->hdr.next_command and the chained header append/goto read_more_data path. The older unbounded helper and 256-slot array are prerequisites; without the chained receive loop they do not contain the advisory's complete repeated-append mechanism.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: 189e5ed^ resolves to the extant commit 984d7ede77e003ac1692f18318f6e17cdc81e1e0. Its lib/socket.c has no next_command/is_chained receive loop and initializes a single response's input vector set directly, while its helper is already unbounded. Thus the complete chained-PDU overflow mechanism is absent in the immediate parent.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED: 189e5ed is an ordinary one-parent commit, not a merge; the local commit object and GitHub commit API agree on the sole parent 984d7ede. GitHub reports no associated pull request, and no finer public member commit is exposed. Although the feature commit touches multiple receive-path files, it is the smallest surviving public first-write object and needs no merge-member decomposition.
protocol_checks.affected_and_fixed_release_membership: CONFIRMED: ancestry checks show libsmb2-1.0 predates the BIC, while v1.0.0, v6.0.0/libsmb2-6.0, libsmb2-6.1, and libsmb2-6.2 contain 189e5ed and do not contain 5e75eeb. No repository tag contains 5e75eeb; current HEAD c8a2eebd79085bd08fe0fe804ce3ec807df7d02f does. The reporter's advisory material says versions 1.0-6.2 before the fix; the CNA prose's narrower '6.2+' wording is not supported by the repository ancestry, and the CNA structured affected version is only n/a.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED: cited commit 5e75eebf922b338cdb548d60cffb3b997d2a12e8, whose parent 4a2c595 still has both the unbounded sink and chained loop, adds the pre-write niov >= SMB2_MAX_VECTORS guard and is therefore the first direct sink-closing fix. Follow-up 883e787426df52dd19206234d7278d46ac997668 changes overflow to NULL and checks callers, improving failure handling without changing which commit first prevents the OOB write. Vendor acceptance is corroborated by merged PR 431.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: CONFIRMED: the raw 189e5ed commit object names Ronnie Sahlberg as author and committer and contains only Signed-off-by: Ronnie Sahlberg. It has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Copilot, Cursor, Claude, GPT, bot identity, or other AI marker. findings: CVE.org currently records CVE-2025-57632 as PUBLISHED; GHSA-h8w6-x833-p4x4 has withdrawn_at=null, and merged upstream PR 431 corroborates vendor acknowledgement, so FALSE_POSITIVE is not warranted.
